picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب phonics book سے نیا word [a student] کرائیں، تو prescribed word cards کو ترتیب سے مکمل استعمال کریں اور ہر card کے بعد بچوں کو سوچنے کے لیے wait time دیں، جیسے [a student] کو دیا تھا۔
picks.subject: english

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب بچے پودے کی تصویر بنائیں، تو پہلے predict کروائیں کہ پانی کون سا حصہ لیتا ہے اور arrows سے دکھائیں، پھر open-ended question پوچھ کر wait time دیں۔
picks.subject: General Science

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب کوئی بچہ سورج یا سمندر کو قدرتی وسائل میں شامل کرے تو فہرست دہرانے کے بجائے بورڈ پر T-chart بنائیں، ایک open-ended question پوچھیں اور wait time دیں۔
picks.subject: general_knowledge

picks.card: Next class, when groups start designing the rice-bowl and string-phone experiment, wait 5–8 seconds after their first hesitant idea and ask 'what if' before stepping in with the method.
picks.subject: science

picks.card: Next class, when a child answers with just one word like 'longest,' use the two-line feedback: 'Thank you — try again like this,' model a full sentence, then ask them to explain why it's comparative.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a child gives a one-word answer like '[a student]', give wait time and offer simple word choices (scary, funny, exciting) to help them build a fuller opinion.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a child answers with just one or two words about prepositions, pair them up to build their own sentences using 'after' or 'away', then ask why that word fits better.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب بچے '[a student]' پر 'pair echo & explain' کریں تو 4-6 جوڑوں کے پاس جا کر دیکھیں وہ کام پر [a student] ہیں اور جواب سے پہلے wait time دیں۔
picks.subject: urdu

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں، جب کوئی بچہ صرف [a student]، تو پہلے خود ایک open-ended question کا exemplar جواب دیں، پھر pair-share کے لیے وقت دیں تاکہ وہ [a student] کی طرح خود سوال بنائیں۔
picks.subject: english

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب 'future' والے سبق کا اختتام ہو تو 'سمجھ آ گئی؟' پوچھنے کے بجائے دو بچوں سے 'آج میں نے سیکھا ___' مکمل کروائیں، اور جواب سے پہلے چند سیکنڈز کی wait time دیں تاکہ وہ جلدی میں نہ بولیں بلکہ سوچ کر بتائیں۔
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a student answers skip-counting or repeated addition with just a number, pause and ask them to show it on the number line and explain how they got there.
picks.subject: maths

picks.card: Next class, when a child gives a one-word off-target answer like 'left' for 'bright', pause and offer two small hints, giving 5-8 seconds wait time before moving on.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a student says 'I can't draw this festival picture,' model a rough sketch in 3 steps, ask 'How did you draw it?', and wait 5 seconds before checking work.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a one-word answer like 'noun' comes back, ask pairs 'Why does this verb take -s?', give 30 seconds, then cold-call someone to explain.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a student names a wrong denominator like [a student]'s '7', pause, give 8-12 seconds of wait time, and ask them to draw the fraction on the board to show the numerator and denominator.
picks.subject: maths

picks.card: Next class, when reviewing the balloon division answers on the board, ask 'How many of you got 3? Raise your hands' before confirming the answer.
picks.subject: maths

picks.card: Next class, when you ask 'Why was [a student] sad?', pause for wait time, then let students choose: copy the sentence, write why she felt sad, or add an alternative ending.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a student answers in fragments about orbit or [a student] [a student], model once, then have them reformulate using a helping verb frame, then ask one open follow-up question and wait.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a pupil repeats 'protector' instead of 'love', run Think 30 seconds, Pair 60 seconds, then ask one pair 'Why did you choose that word?', give wait time, and appreciate their answer.
picks.subject: english

picks.card: Next class, when a student answers in one word like '75', ask 'How else could we check this answer?', wait 8 seconds, then have partners pair-check using the checklist: [a student] of 1 = [a student] ..., multiplication shown, [a student] written.
picks.subject: maths

picks.card: Next class, when a student wavers on 'fish lives on land,' say 'Stop. Think 3 seconds. Then raise your hand,' then add one sentence modeling why, before moving to the next open 'why' question.
picks.subject: general_knowledge

picks.card: اگلی کلاس میں جب بچے 'کتاب' یا 'کالا' قاف کے لیے بولیں، بورڈ پر دو کالم بنا کر sorting activity کریں — ایک کالم 'کاف' اور دوسرا 'قاف'، ہر لفظ رکھنے پر open-ended question پوچھیں 'یہ یہاں کیوں رکھا؟' اور 3-5 سیکنڈ کا wait time دیں۔
